name: mygov
description: Malaysia government open data: weather, fuel prices, CPI, GTFS transit, live trains.

interface.shortDescription: Malaysia gov open data: weather, fuel, CPI, transit.
interface.longDescription: Query Malaysian government open data via api.data.gov.my: 7-day weather forecasts and warnings (MET Malaysia), weekly fuel prices, CPI and economic statistics (OpenDOSM), GTFS static schedules and live vehicle positions (KTMB, Prasarana, mybas).
defaultPrompt: What's the weather in Kota Bharu this week?
What are the latest fuel prices in Malaysia?
Show me live KTMB train positions.
